specification.objective: Provide site-wide, keyboard-accessible controls for text scaling and reduced motion that remain usable on narrow viewports.

requirements.statement: The site exposes a clearly named accessibility control and an operable panel to adjust text size, reduce animations, and restore defaults.
Accessibility settings apply throughout the site and the control remains accessible and responsive at mobile and desktop widths.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Widget tests verify the named launcher, text scaling controls, reduce-animation toggle, reset behavior, and semantic state.
Widget tests verify adjusted MediaQuery settings and fit at a 320-pixel viewport; CUA verifies the rendered panel in the browser.

invariants.statement: Default text scaling and animation behavior are unchanged until the visitor adjusts a setting.
Accessibility tools do not navigate away from or obscure the underlying page when closed.

forbidden_states.statement: Accessibility controls are unavailable to keyboard or screen-reader users.
The compact viewport causes horizontal overflow in the accessibility panel.

inputs.statement: User activation of the global accessibility launcher and panel controls.

outputs.statement: Site-wide MediaQuery text scaling and reduced-animation preference.

failure_semantics.statement: If the panel is dismissed, current session settings remain active and the page remains usable.
